title: Styled CoT forgery in user turn
source: adapted: Ye et al. 2026, 'Prompt Injection as Role Confusion' (arXiv:2603.12277), styled vs destyled
notes: The paper reports that destyling a CoT forgery (sty-002b) drops attack success from ~61% to ~10%. A good detector should separate the two.
